description: Defines functions for inferring tensor sizes and shapes, handling -1 dimensions, and shape validation in PyTorch's ATen library.

methods.name: infer_size_impl
methods.description: Infers tensor shape sizes, handling -1 for dynamic dimensions, ensuring shape compatibility with total number of elements.

methods.name: infer_size
methods.description: Infers tensor size as a vector of int64_t based on shape and total number of elements.

methods.name: infer_size_dv
methods.description: Infers tensor size as a DimVector or SymDimVector based on shape and total number of elements.
